solutionSource.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

entries.clue: Second city storing rubbish in pile (7,4)

indicatorNotes.storing: the city keeps the rubbish stored inside it

blocks.note: Ely, the cathedral city in Cambridgeshire

annotation.surface: Someone's second city is hoarding a heap of junk.
annotation.walkthrough: 'Pile' looks like the rubbish heap; it is a grand house, as in 'the family pile'.
annotation.definitionFit: A pile is informal British for a large, imposing house, which a stately home is.

entries.clue: Sibling contracted in MI6 (3)

blocks.note: the initials of MI6's official name, the Secret Intelligence Service

annotation.surface: A brother or sister has been hired by the British secret service.
annotation.walkthrough: 'Contracted' pretends someone was hired by MI6; it just means shortened. MI6 is Britain's foreign intelligence agency.
annotation.definitionFit: Sis is a shortened sister, and SIS is MI6's formal name.

entries.clue: Daft mimicry always includes elevated material (5)

indicatorNotes.includes: AY holds the other piece inside it
indicatorNotes.elevated: raised up, so in a down clue the word reads bottom to top

annotation.surface: Silly impersonation that keeps turning up in lofty writing.
annotation.walkthrough: AY for always is an old poetic word the crossword leans on. Apery is the silly imitating that apes do.
annotation.definitionFit: Apery is foolish mimicry, aping someone.

entries.clue: Energy cuts end in catastrophe — and darkness (7)

indicatorNotes.end in: take the final letter of the next word

annotation.surface: Power cuts end in disaster and everything goes dark.
annotation.walkthrough: The surface reads like a blackout story; 'cuts' is a plain verb meaning clips.
annotation.definitionFit: An eclipse is a darkening, the blotting out of light.

entries.clue: County now divided dismisses charter (9)

blocks.note: a bowler yorks a batsman by bowling them out with a yorker
to charter a boat or plane is to hire it

annotation.surface: A county, now split up, throws out its founding charter.
annotation.walkthrough: In cricket a yorker is a ball pitched at the batsman's feet, and yorking someone is dismissing them with one. Yorkshire, England's largest historic county, has been split into several administrative counties since 1974.
annotation.definitionFit: Yorkshire is a county, today divided into North, South, West and East Riding.

entries.clue: Terriers beset by obsessive behaviour in four pairs? (5)

indicatorNotes.beset by: surrounded by, so OCD goes around TA

blocks.note: the Territorial Army, whose soldiers are nicknamed Terriers

annotation.surface: Dogs surrounded by compulsive habits, perhaps in two-by-two sets.
annotation.walkthrough: Terriers look like dogs; they are TA volunteers, the UK's reserve army. The question mark flags that four pairs is a roundabout way of saying eight.
annotation.definitionFit: An octad is a group of eight, which is four pairs.

entries.clue: Earl to supply large vessel with guns and flag (7)

blocks.note: E is the abbreviation for earl
to supply with guns is to arm
finishes the ARM sense begun by 'to supply': to supply with guns
Noah's ark, the largest of vessels

annotation.surface: A nobleman must fit out a big ship with guns and colours.
annotation.walkthrough: 'With guns' finishes the ARM idea: to supply with guns. 'Flag' looks like a ship's ensign; it is the verb, to mark out for attention.
annotation.definitionFit: To earmark something is to flag it for a particular purpose.

entries.clue: Female domestic avoiding male helper (3)

indicatorNotes.avoiding: the maid does without the M

blocks.note: a maid is a female servant

annotation.surface: A housemaid keeps away from the man who assists her.
annotation.walkthrough: 'Male helper' reads as one phrase; the break comes after male, leaving helper as the definition.
annotation.definitionFit: An aid is a helper, as in a teaching aid or a person who assists.

entries.clue: Article: story upcoming beat journalist turned away (9)

indicatorNotes.upcoming: coming up the column in a down clue, so the word reads backwards

blocks.note: a story can be a lie
to tan someone's hide is to beat them

annotation.surface: A news article: an upcoming story about a reporter's patch being dropped.
annotation.walkthrough: 'Upcoming beat journalist' reads like a reporter's next assignment; beat is the verb, tan.
annotation.definitionFit: A plain synonym: someone alienated has been made hostile and turned away from former friends.

entries.clue: Essential fact about English team, Reading perhaps (11)

blocks.note: a datum is a single fact
reading is one of the three Rs

annotation.surface: A key fact about an English football team, such as Reading.
annotation.walkthrough: Reading looks like the football club; it is one of the three Rs, reading, writing and 'rithmetic, so it gives R.
annotation.definitionFit: A plain synonym in noun form: desideratum, Latin for 'thing wanted', names something needed or essential.
annotation.definitionNote: Essential is used as a noun here, an essential thing.

entries.clue: Fish devouring famous bat — suspect treachery? (5,1,3)

blocks.note: a smelt is a small fish
Brian Lara, the great West Indian batsman

annotation.surface: A fish eats a famous flying bat, which looks like foul play.
annotation.walkthrough: Bat is cricket slang for a batsman, and Brian Lara is one of the game's greats. The question mark flags that treachery is only one thing you might smell a rat about.
annotation.definitionFit: An idiom for sensing foul play, of which treachery is one kind.

entries.clue: Borders crossing close to free French city (5)

indicatorNotes.crossing: RIMS goes across the E, holding it
indicatorNotes.close to: a close is an end, so the close to free is its final letter

annotation.surface: Frontiers opening up near a French city that has been liberated.
annotation.walkthrough: 'Close to free' reads like nearly liberated; close is the noun, the end of the word.
annotation.definitionFit: Reims is a city in northern France, the champagne capital.

entries.clue: My soul, corrupt, filled with power in divine residence (7)

indicatorNotes.corrupt: the letters of MY SOUL are corrupted, rearranged

annotation.surface: A sinner fears their tainted soul, now full of power, living in heaven.
annotation.walkthrough: 'My soul' sounds like an exclamation; it is just the letters to rearrange.
annotation.definitionFit: Mount Olympus was the home of the Greek gods.

entries.clue: Deprived character of duck meat on bread roll (6,5)

blocks.note: a duck is a score of nought in cricket, so O
liver is offal eaten as meat
a twist is a bread roll of twisted dough

annotation.surface: A hungry figure whose meal is duck and meat in a bread roll.
annotation.walkthrough: The meal suits the answer: Dickens's workhouse orphan who famously asked for more. In cricket a duck is a score of nought, hence O.
annotation.definitionFit: Oliver Twist is Dickens's deprived workhouse orphan.

entries.clue: Exhausted academician has eaten outside (7)

indicatorNotes.outside: DINED is placed outside, wrapping round RA

annotation.surface: A worn-out scholar has had dinner out.
annotation.walkthrough: 'Eaten outside' looks like a picnic; outside is the container instruction.
annotation.definitionFit: Drained means exhausted, all energy gone.

entries.clue: Jack, released from harm, put into operation (5)

indicatorNotes.released from: the J is let out of INJURE

annotation.surface: Jack, freed from danger, is put straight into action.
annotation.walkthrough: The usual meaning of inure is to accustom; the older legal sense, also spelt enure, is to take effect or put into use, which is what the definition uses.
annotation.definitionFit: Inure in its legal sense means to come into operation or put into use.

entries.clue: Hesitant centaur terribly popular (9)

indicatorNotes.terribly: the letters of CENTAUR are made a mess of

annotation.surface: A nervous centaur is dreadfully well liked.
annotation.walkthrough: 'Terribly popular' reads as a single phrase meaning very popular; terribly is the anagram indicator and popular is IN.
annotation.definitionFit: A plain synonym: being unsure is what makes a person hesitate.

entries.clue: Curry perhaps one Kelvin creates when drunk (3-6)

indicatorNotes.when drunk: the letters are drunk, reeling into a new order

blocks.note: K = kelvin, the unit of temperature

annotation.surface: A curry is the kind of thing a man called Kelvin makes after a few drinks.
annotation.walkthrough: Curry looks like the late-night takeaway; it is John Curry, the British figure skater who won Olympic gold in 1976. 'Perhaps' flags him as one example.
annotation.definitionFit: John Curry was a champion ice-skater, so he is an ice-skater by example.

entries.clue: Some exudation? Cap damaged mescal bottles (9)

indicatorNotes.damaged: the letters of MESCAL are damaged, rearranged
indicatorNotes.bottles: the anagram holds TOP inside it

blocks.note: a cap is a top, as on a bottle

annotation.surface: A leaky drink: the cap is broken on the bottles of mescal.
annotation.walkthrough: The drinks-cabinet surface uses 'bottles' as a noun; it is the verb, to hold inside. The question mark flags that ectoplasm is a spooky example of an exudation.
annotation.definitionFit: Ectoplasm is the substance said to ooze from a spiritualist medium.

entries.clue: Superb basic unit in old hospital department (9)

indicatorNotes.in: CELL goes inside the other pieces

blocks.note: the cell is the basic unit of life

annotation.surface: A top-notch basic ward in an old hospital department.
annotation.walkthrough: ENT (ear, nose and throat) is the standard hospital department. CELL goes between EX and ENT.
annotation.definitionFit: A plain synonym: both words mean of the very highest quality.

entries.clue: Uncouth, rather rowdy: time to replace Democrat (7)

indicatorNotes.to replace: to replace something is to take its place, so T takes the place of D

annotation.surface: A crude, noisy crowd, and it is time to get rid of the Democrat.
annotation.walkthrough: The political surface is a red herring; D for Democrat is simply the letter that T replaces in LOUDISH.
annotation.definitionFit: Loutish means uncouth, like a lout.

entries.clue: Tool secures device expelling content behind washer (5)

indicatorNotes.secures: BIT holds the next piece fast inside
indicatorNotes.expelling content: device loses its insides, leaving the outer letters

blocks.note: a drill bit is a tool

annotation.surface: A tool grips a gadget that pumps out what it holds, behind a washer.
annotation.walkthrough: 'Behind washer' reads as a position after a washing machine; it is a washer for one's behind.
annotation.definitionFit: A bidet is a low basin for washing one's bottom.

entries.clue: Erstwhile leader, Liberal in corrupt victory (7)

indicatorNotes.in: in says the Liberal's L sits inside the other letters

annotation.surface: A former leader, a Liberal, caught up in a crooked election win.
annotation.walkthrough: The Liberal of the surface was not Baldwin, a Conservative; L just goes into BAD. Stanley Baldwin was British prime minister three times between the wars.
annotation.definitionFit: Stanley Baldwin led Britain as prime minister in the 1920s and 1930s.

entries.clue: Husband gripped by depression no longer able to function (7)

indicatorNotes.gripped by: what is gripped is held tight inside, so H is held inside TROUGH

blocks.note: a trough is a low point or depression

annotation.surface: A husband so gripped by depression he can no longer cope.
annotation.walkthrough: Depression reads as low mood; it is a dip in the land or a weather trough.
annotation.definitionFit: Through means finished, done for, no longer able to carry on.

entries.clue: Those without residence first to leave Martian moon (5)

indicatorNotes.first to leave: the first letter leaves, walking out of the word

blocks.note: Phobos is the larger moon of Mars
P, the first letter, is removed

annotation.surface: Homeless people are the first to quit a moon of Mars.
annotation.walkthrough: Phobos and Deimos are the two moons of Mars.
annotation.definitionFit: A plain synonym: hobos are itinerant American tramps with no fixed home.

entries.clue: Religious traveller turning cheek, resolute (7)

indicatorNotes.turning: turning round means facing the other way, so LIP reads backwards

blocks.note: grim = resolute, as in grim determination

annotation.surface: A devout traveller firmly turns the other cheek.
annotation.walkthrough: 'Turning cheek' echoes turning the other cheek, which suits a pilgrim; cheek is lip, as in 'less of your lip'.
annotation.definitionFit: A pilgrim travels to a holy place for religious reasons.

entries.clue: Admirer unveils boxing show aired again (5)

indicatorNotes.boxing: the words box the answer up inside them

annotation.surface: A fan reveals a boxing show being broadcast again.
annotation.walkthrough: Boxing looks like the sport being shown; it is the instruction to find a word boxed inside.
annotation.definitionFit: A plain synonym from broadcasting: a repeat of a programme is called a rerun, especially in the US.

entries.clue: Irish-American with first question for Arab? (5)

blocks.note: I, the Roman numeral one, is first

annotation.surface: An Irish-American whose first question is about an Arab.
annotation.walkthrough: The question mark marks Arab as a definition by example: not every Iraqi is an Arab, but many are.
annotation.definitionFit: An Iraqi may be an Arab, most Iraqis being Arabs.

entries.clue: Renegade wife tucked into ruptured sausage (9)

indicatorNotes.tucked into: RAT and W go inside BURST

blocks.note: a rat is a deserter, a renegade

annotation.surface: A disloyal wife tucks into a sausage that has split open.
annotation.walkthrough: The surface has the wife eating; here 'tucked into' means placed inside, not eating.
annotation.definitionFit: A definition by kind: bratwurst is a German pork sausage, usually fried or grilled.

entries.clue: Digital feature starts with thesis on electronics (3)

indicatorNotes.starts with: take the starts of the words that follow

annotation.surface: A dissertation on electronics opens with a digital feature.
annotation.walkthrough: Digital looks like electronics; it is about digits, fingers and toes.
annotation.definitionFit: A pun on 'digital': toes are digits of the foot, so one is a feature of the digits.

entries.clue: Tail removed from fish in barrel (3)

indicatorNotes.Tail removed from: the last letter is cut off

annotation.surface: Cutting the tail off a fish kept in a barrel.
annotation.walkthrough: The surface evokes shooting fish in a barrel; 'in' is just the link to the definition.
annotation.definitionFit: A plain synonym: a tun is a large cask, traditionally for wine or beer.

entries.clue: Artist drawn in by enigmatic Chinese title (3,8)

indicatorNotes.drawn in by: to be drawn in is to be pulled inside, so EMIN goes inside the anagram
indicatorNotes.enigmatic: puzzling, so the letters of CHINESE are scrambled

annotation.surface: An artist is drawn to a mysterious Chinese honorific.
annotation.walkthrough: Tracey Emin is a British artist famous for her unmade bed; crosswords use her often. 'Drawn' suits an artist but means pulled in.
annotation.definitionFit: A definition by kind: it is the honorific used to address or refer to a Roman Catholic cardinal.
